Basic Information.Supported CPU:
Supports AMD Ryzen 5000 Series, 5000 G-Series, 4000 G-Series, 3000 Series and 3000 G-Series desktop processors
Socket AM4
Basic Information.Audio:
Realtek ALC897 Codec
7.1-Channel High Definition Audio

Expansion Slots.PCI:
1x PCI-E x16 slot
2x PCI-E x1 slot
PCI_E1 Gen PCIe 4.0 supports up to x16 (From CPU)
PCI_E2 Gen PCIe 3.0 supports up to x1 (From Chipset)
PCI_E3 Gen PCIe 3.0 supports up to x1 (From Chipset)

2x M.2

M.2_2 Source (From Chipset) supports up to PCIe 3.0 x4 , supports 2280/2260/2242 devices

• 1DPC 1R Max speed up to 4400+ MT/s

• 2DPC 2R Max speed up to 3466+ MT/s
Supports JEDEC Speed
Supports Dual-Channel mode
Supports non-ECC, un-buffered memory
Supports Memory Overclocking by A-XMP OC mode

4x SATA 6G
